                UNKNOWN); FY is the 2-digit fiscal year of the registrationDate (the fiscal year
                starts on 1 July); HASH8 is the first eight upper-case hex characters of SHA-256
                over (normalizedTelephone + lastName); and CHK is a single Luhn check digit over
                the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. On collision with an existing member id a
                '-<n>' suffix (smallest n of 2 or more) is appended.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW271A2B3C4D5'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, derived at read time from the (business-day-adjusted)
                registrationDate and formatted 'FY<YY>', where YY is the last two digits of the
                fiscal year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July, so a registrationDate on or after
                1 July belongs to the fiscal year labelled with the next calendar year (e.g.
                2026-07-01 -> 'FY27'), and a date before 1 July belongs to the current calendar
                year (e.g. 2026-06-30 -> 'FY26'). Absent when the owner has no registrationDate.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for the owner's household: the first 12 hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name and the postcode. It is
                deterministic, so every owner with the same last name and postcode derives
                the same value automatically. Owners created without a postcode have no
                household and no householdId.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key, consolidating all duplicate detection into a
                single value formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (the email and
                householdId components are empty when absent). Two owners are the same identity only
                when their whole key matches; a create is rejected with 409 only on an exact
                full-key match.
              type: string
              example: '+616085550002||A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was created,
                already shared the same first name and last name (compared
                case-insensitively). Zero when the name was unique on creation.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, assigned at creation. Start at 0 and
                accumulate: +2 when an email is present, +1 when the owner's namesakeCount
                is 0, +2 for a household of 3 or more and +3 for tenure over one fiscal year
                (more than one elapsed fiscal year since the registrationDate, the fiscal year
                starting on 1 July).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, derived at creation from the
                membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5 and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality, derived at read time from the city via the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or
                'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone, derived at read time from the locality/region
                via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the
                region has no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived at read time:
                'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Derived at read time: true when more than 80 owners have already been
                created today (owners sharing this owner's registrationDate), otherwise
                false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                Derived at read time: true when the owner's city already holds between 40 and
                49 owners (inclusive), approaching the per-city capacity limit of 50, otherwise
                false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                Derived at read time: true when any of these hold — the owner is a possible
                duplicate ('possibleDuplicate' true), the owner's email domain is
                disposable-adjacent (its second-level label matches a known disposable-email
                provider, e.g. 'mailinator.org' or a subdomain of one, even though an exactly
                disposable domain is rejected at creation), or the owner's city is over its
                soft capacity (already holds at least 40 owners, the per-city warning
                threshold) — otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Assigned at creation: true when the new owner is not a hard duplicate but
                shares an existing (non-deleted) owner's last name and postcode while having a
                different telephone, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner whose last name and postcode this owner shares
                (with a different telephone), set when 'possibleDuplicate' is true and absent
                otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                Derived at read time from 'birthDate' relative to 'registrationDate':
                'MINOR' when the owner is under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and 'SENIOR'
                at 65 or older. Absent when the owner has no birthDate.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                Derived at read time as '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when the owner's
                membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the
                owner's locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. DELETE /api/owners/{id} sets this true and
                retains the record, so the owner is still readable here; the create endpoint's
                duplicate and identity checks ignore owners flagged deleted. False for a newly
                created owner.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            Optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of 'MR', 'MRS', 'MS'
            or 'DR'. When present it drives the derived 'salutation'. Stored and
            returned as given.
          type: string
          example: 'DR'
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility (the flat form) and always returned. When structured
            address fields are supplied it is the composed, normalized value: the
            normalized 'addressLine1', with a single space and the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. LIBERTY STREET'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred
            over the flat 'address' when present; normalized (trim, collapse
            whitespace, upper-case, expand street-type abbreviations) like the flat
            address. An owner is valid when it supplies EITHER a non-blank
            'addressLine1' or the flat 'address', plus a city.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address
            (e.g. unit or apartment). Normalized like 'addressLine1' and, when
            present, appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            Optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be valid for
            the owner's city per the fixed region table (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099,
            Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region
            accepts any 4-digit postcode. Out-of-range postcodes are rejected with 400. When
            omitted the owner is still accepted. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to E.164:
            a leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise country code
            '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits;
            spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped and the result must have 8 to 15 digits
            after the '+'. The E.164 value is stored and returned (e.g. '0412 345 678' ->
            '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            Optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form. When
            omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            Optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form. When
            present it is stored and returned as given and drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag set on create to acknowledge that this owner shares a
            household with an existing owner. The household is keyed on last name and
            postcode, so owners with the same last name and postcode share a household
            automatically. When omitted or false, creating a second owner in an existing
            household is rejected with 409; when true the create is allowed as a declared
            household member (and such a member is not flagged as a possible duplicate).
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical URL of this owner, derived at read time as
                '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The pet owner's salutation, derived at read time as the title and
                last name separated by a single space (e.g. 'DR Franklin'), or just
                the last name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The pet owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the
                stored first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans at read time: the
                country code, a single space, then the national digits grouped in threes
                from the left (e.g. '+61412345678' -> '+61 412 345 678'). The raw
                'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member identifier, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' and
                assigned at creation: REGION is the region code (from postcode, else city, else
                UNKNOWN); FY is the 2-digit fiscal year of the registrationDate (the fiscal year
                starts on 1 July); HASH8 is the first eight upper-case hex characters of SHA-256
                over (normalizedTelephone + lastName); and CHK is a single Luhn check digit over
                the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. On collision with an existing member id a
                '-<n>' suffix (smallest n of 2 or more) is appended.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW271A2B3C4D5'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, derived at read time from the (business-day-adjusted)
                registrationDate and formatted 'FY<YY>', where YY is the last two digits of the
                fiscal year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July, so a registrationDate on or after
                1 July belongs to the fiscal year labelled with the next calendar year (e.g.
                2026-07-01 -> 'FY27'), and a date before 1 July belongs to the current calendar
                year (e.g. 2026-06-30 -> 'FY26'). Absent when the owner has no registrationDate.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for the owner's household: the first 12 hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name and the postcode. It is
                deterministic, so every owner with the same last name and postcode derives
                the same value automatically. Owners created without a postcode have no
                household and no householdId.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key, consolidating all duplicate detection into a
                single value formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (the email and
                householdId components are empty when absent). Two owners are the same identity only
                when their whole key matches; a create is rejected with 409 only on an exact
                full-key match.
              type: string
              example: '+616085550002||A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was created,
                already shared the same first name and last name (compared
                case-insensitively). Zero when the name was unique on creation.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, assigned at creation. Start at 0 and
                accumulate: +2 when an email is present, +1 when the owner's namesakeCount
                is 0, +2 for a household of 3 or more and +3 for tenure over one fiscal year
                (more than one elapsed fiscal year since the registrationDate, the fiscal year
                starting on 1 July).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, derived at creation from the
                membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5 and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality, derived at read time from the city via the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or
                'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone, derived at read time from the locality/region
                via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the
                region has no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived at read time:
                'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Derived at read time: true when more than 80 owners have already been
                created today (owners sharing this owner's registrationDate), otherwise
                false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                Derived at read time: true when the owner's city already holds between 40 and
                49 owners (inclusive), approaching the per-city capacity limit of 50, otherwise
                false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                Derived at read time: true when any of these hold — the owner is a possible
                duplicate ('possibleDuplicate' true), the owner's email domain is
                disposable-adjacent (its second-level label matches a known disposable-email
                provider, e.g. 'mailinator.org' or a subdomain of one, even though an exactly
                disposable domain is rejected at creation), or the owner's city is over its
                soft capacity (already holds at least 40 owners, the per-city warning
                threshold) — otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Assigned at creation: true when the new owner is not a hard duplicate but
                shares an existing (non-deleted) owner's last name and postcode while having a
                different telephone, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner whose last name and postcode this owner shares
                (with a different telephone), set when 'possibleDuplicate' is true and absent
                otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                Derived at read time from 'birthDate' relative to 'registrationDate':
                'MINOR' when the owner is under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and 'SENIOR'
                at 65 or older. Absent when the owner has no birthDate.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                Derived at read time as '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when the owner's
                membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the
                owner's locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. DELETE /api/owners/{id} sets this true and
                retains the record, so the owner is still readable here; the create endpoint's
                duplicate and identity checks ignore owners flagged deleted. False for a newly
                created owner.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

info:
  title: Spring PetClinic
  description: Spring PetClinic Sample Application.
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    url: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
  version: '1.0'
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api
tags:
  - name: oops
    description: Endpoint which always returns an error.
  - name: owners
    description: Endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: owner-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: users
    description: Endpoints related to users.
  - name: pets
    description: Endpoints related to pets.
  - name: pet-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pets.
  - name: vets
    description: Endpoints related to vets.
  - name: visits
    description: Endpoints related to vet visits.
  - name: pettypes
    description: Endpoints related to pet types.
  - name: specialties
    description: Endpoints related to vet specialties.
paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            Optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of 'MR', 'MRS', 'MS'
            or 'DR'. When present it drives the derived 'salutation'. Stored and
            returned as given.
          type: string
          example: 'DR'
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility (the flat form) and always returned. When structured
            address fields are supplied it is the composed, normalized value: the
            normalized 'addressLine1', with a single space and the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. LIBERTY STREET'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred
            over the flat 'address' when present; normalized (trim, collapse
            whitespace, upper-case, expand street-type abbreviations) like the flat
            address. An owner is valid when it supplies EITHER a non-blank
            'addressLine1' or the flat 'address', plus a city.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address
            (e.g. unit or apartment). Normalized like 'addressLine1' and, when
            present, appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            Optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be valid for
            the owner's city per the fixed region table (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099,
            Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region
            accepts any 4-digit postcode. Out-of-range postcodes are rejected with 400. When
            omitted the owner is still accepted. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to E.164:
            a leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise country code
            '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits;
            spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped and the result must have 8 to 15 digits
            after the '+'. The E.164 value is stored and returned (e.g. '0412 345 678' ->
            '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            Optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form. When
            omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            Optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form. When
            present it is stored and returned as given and drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag set on create to acknowledge that this owner shares a
            household with an existing owner. The household is keyed on last name and
            postcode, so owners with the same last name and postcode share a household
            automatically. When omitted or false, creating a second owner in an existing
            household is rejected with 409; when true the create is allowed as a declared
            household member (and such a member is not flagged as a possible duplicate).
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical URL of this owner, derived at read time as
                '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The pet owner's salutation, derived at read time as the title and
                last name separated by a single space (e.g. 'DR Franklin'), or just
                the last name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The pet owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the
                stored first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans at read time: the
                country code, a single space, then the national digits grouped in threes
                from the left (e.g. '+61412345678' -> '+61 412 345 678'). The raw
                'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The owner API contract version. Fixed at 2 for the identity-v2 response shape, in
                which the owner's derived identifiers are grouped under the nested 'identity' object
                (rather than at the top level) and every identifier is rederived with a version-2
                algorithm that mixes in a fixed 'V2' tag.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, derived at read time from the (business-day-adjusted)
                registrationDate and formatted 'FY<YY>', where YY is the last two digits of the
                fiscal year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July, so a registrationDate on or after
                1 July belongs to the fiscal year labelled with the next calendar year (e.g.
                2026-07-01 -> 'FY27'), and a date before 1 July belongs to the current calendar
                year (e.g. 2026-06-30 -> 'FY26'). Absent when the owner has no registrationDate.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for the owner's household: the first 12 hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name and the postcode. It is
                deterministic, so every owner with the same last name and postcode derives
                the same value automatically. Owners created without a postcode have no
                household and no householdId.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key, consolidating all duplicate detection into a
                single value formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (the email and
                householdId components are empty when absent). Two owners are the same identity only
                when their whole key matches; a create is rejected with 409 only on an exact
                full-key match.
              type: string
              example: '+616085550002||A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was created,
                already shared the same first name and last name (compared
                case-insensitively). Zero when the name was unique on creation.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, assigned at creation. Start at 0 and
                accumulate: +2 when an email is present, +1 when the owner's namesakeCount
                is 0, +2 for a household of 3 or more and +3 for tenure over one fiscal year
                (more than one elapsed fiscal year since the registrationDate, the fiscal year
                starting on 1 July).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, derived at creation from the
                membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5 and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality, derived at read time from the city via the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or
                'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone, derived at read time from the locality/region
                via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the
                region has no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived at read time:
                'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Derived at read time: true when more than 80 owners have already been
                created today (owners sharing this owner's registrationDate), otherwise
                false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                Derived at read time: true when the owner's city already holds between 40 and
                49 owners (inclusive), approaching the per-city capacity limit of 50, otherwise
                false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                Derived at read time: true when any of these hold — the owner is a possible
                duplicate ('possibleDuplicate' true), the owner's email domain is
                disposable-adjacent (its second-level label matches a known disposable-email
                provider, e.g. 'mailinator.org' or a subdomain of one, even though an exactly
                disposable domain is rejected at creation), or the owner's city is over its
                soft capacity (already holds at least 40 owners, the per-city warning
                threshold) — otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Assigned at creation: true when the new owner is not a hard duplicate but
                shares an existing (non-deleted) owner's last name and postcode while having a
                different telephone, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner whose last name and postcode this owner shares
                (with a different telephone), set when 'possibleDuplicate' is true and absent
                otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                Derived at read time from 'birthDate' relative to 'registrationDate':
                'MINOR' when the owner is under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and 'SENIOR'
                at 65 or older. Absent when the owner has no birthDate.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                Derived at read time as '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when the owner's
                membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the
                owner's locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. DELETE /api/owners/{id} sets this true and
                retains the record, so the owner is still readable here; the create endpoint's
                duplicate and identity checks ignore owners flagged deleted. False for a newly
                created owner.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            Optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of 'MR', 'MRS', 'MS'
            or 'DR'. When present it drives the derived 'salutation'. Stored and
            returned as given.
          type: string
          example: 'DR'
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility (the flat form) and always returned. When structured
            address fields are supplied it is the composed, normalized value: the
            normalized 'addressLine1', with a single space and the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. LIBERTY STREET'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred
            over the flat 'address' when present; normalized (trim, collapse
            whitespace, upper-case, expand street-type abbreviations) like the flat
            address. An owner is valid when it supplies EITHER a non-blank
            'addressLine1' or the flat 'address', plus a city.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address
            (e.g. unit or apartment). Normalized like 'addressLine1' and, when
            present, appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            Optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be valid for
            the owner's city per the fixed region table (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099,
            Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region
            accepts any 4-digit postcode. Out-of-range postcodes are rejected with 400. When
            omitted the owner is still accepted. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to E.164:
            a leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise country code
            '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits;
            spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped and the result must have 8 to 15 digits
            after the '+'. The E.164 value is stored and returned (e.g. '0412 345 678' ->
            '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            Optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form. When
            omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            Optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form. When
            present it is stored and returned as given and drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag set on create to acknowledge that this owner shares a
            household with an existing owner. The household is keyed on last name and
            postcode, so owners with the same last name and postcode share a household
            automatically. When omitted or false, creating a second owner in an existing
            household is rejected with 409; when true the create is allowed as a declared
            household member (and such a member is not flagged as a possible duplicate).
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical URL of this owner, derived at read time as
                '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The pet owner's salutation, derived at read time as the title and
                last name separated by a single space (e.g. 'DR Franklin'), or just
                the last name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The pet owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the
                stored first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans at read time: the
                country code, a single space, then the national digits grouped in threes
                from the left (e.g. '+61412345678' -> '+61 412 345 678'). The raw
                'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The owner API contract version. Fixed at 2 for the identity-v2 response shape, in
                which the owner's derived identifiers are grouped under the nested 'identity' object
                (rather than at the top level) and every identifier is rederived with a version-2
                algorithm that mixes in a fixed 'V2' tag.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, derived at read time from the (business-day-adjusted)
                registrationDate and formatted 'FY<YY>', where YY is the last two digits of the
                fiscal year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July, so a registrationDate on or after
                1 July belongs to the fiscal year labelled with the next calendar year (e.g.
                2026-07-01 -> 'FY27'), and a date before 1 July belongs to the current calendar
                year (e.g. 2026-06-30 -> 'FY26'). Absent when the owner has no registrationDate.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was created,
                already shared the same first name and last name (compared
                case-insensitively). Zero when the name was unique on creation.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, assigned at creation. Start at 0 and
                accumulate: +2 when an email is present, +1 when the owner's namesakeCount
                is 0, +2 for a household of 3 or more and +3 for tenure over one fiscal year
                (more than one elapsed fiscal year since the registrationDate, the fiscal year
                starting on 1 July).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, derived at creation from the
                membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5 and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality, derived at read time from the city via the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or
                'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone, derived at read time from the locality/region
                via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the
                region has no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived at read time:
                'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Derived at read time: true when more than 80 owners have already been
                created today (owners sharing this owner's registrationDate), otherwise
                false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                Derived at read time: true when the owner's city already holds between 40 and
                49 owners (inclusive), approaching the per-city capacity limit of 50, otherwise
                false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                Derived at read time: true when any of these hold — the owner is a possible
                duplicate ('possibleDuplicate' true), the owner's email domain is
                disposable-adjacent (its second-level label matches a known disposable-email
                provider, e.g. 'mailinator.org' or a subdomain of one, even though an exactly
                disposable domain is rejected at creation), or the owner's city is over its
                soft capacity (already holds at least 40 owners, the per-city warning
                threshold) — otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Assigned at creation: true when the new owner is not a hard duplicate but
                shares an existing (non-deleted) owner's last name and postcode while having a
                different telephone, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner whose last name and postcode this owner shares
                (with a different telephone), set when 'possibleDuplicate' is true and absent
                otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                Derived at read time from 'birthDate' relative to 'registrationDate':
                'MINOR' when the owner is under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and 'SENIOR'
                at 65 or older. Absent when the owner has no birthDate.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                Derived at read time as '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when the owner's
                membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the
                owner's locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. DELETE /api/owners/{id} sets this true and
                retains the record, so the owner is still readable here; the create endpoint's
                duplicate and identity checks ignore owners flagged deleted. False for a newly
                created owner.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:

OwnerIdentity:
      title: Owner identity
      description: >-
        The owner's derived identifiers, grouped together under the identity-v2 response shape. All
        three are rederived with a version-2 algorithm that mixes in a fixed 'V2' version tag, so
        every identifier changes and no value produced under version 1 recurs. The plain region code
        still surfaces, unversioned, in the owner's 'locality'.
      type: object
      properties:
        memberId:
          title: Member ID
          description: >-
            The owner's unified member identifier, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' and assigned
            at creation. REGION is the version-2 region code: the plain region (from postcode, else
            city, else UNKNOWN) with the fixed 'V2' tag mixed in (e.g. 'NSWV2'). FY is the 2-digit
            fiscal year of the registrationDate (the fiscal year starts on 1 July); HASH8 is the
            first eight upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over (normalizedTelephone + lastName);
            and CHK is a single Luhn check digit over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. On
            collision with an existing member id a '-<n>' suffix (smallest n of 2 or more) is appended.
          type: string
          example: 'NSWV2271A2B3C4D5'
          readOnly: true
        householdId:
          title: Household ID
          description: >-
            A stable shared identifier for the owner's household: the first 12 hex characters of
            SHA-256 over the fixed 'V2' version tag, the normalized last name and the postcode. It is
            deterministic, so every owner with the same last name and postcode derives the same value
            automatically. Owners created without a postcode have no household and no householdId.
          type: string
          example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
          readOnly: true
        identityKey:
          title: Identity key
          description: >-
            The owner's derived identity key, consolidating all duplicate detection into a single
            value: the lower-case hex SHA-256 over the fixed 'V2' version tag, the normalized
            telephone, the lower-cased email and the Soundex code of the last name. Two owners are the
            same identity only when their whole key matches; a create is rejected with 409 only on an
            exact full-key match.
          type: string
          example: 'e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924'
          readOnly: true

      description: A pet owner.
